name: What is the process for refinishing a log cabin?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for refinishing a log cabin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our refinishing process typically begins with a thorough cleaning of the logs, often using media blasting or power washing to remove old finishes and contaminants. Next, any damaged logs are repaired or replaced. Then, a high-quality stain or sealant is applied in multiple coats for optimal protection and aesthetics. Finally, chinking or caulking may be applied to seal gaps and prevent air or moisture infiltration.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves cleaning, repairing, applying new stain or sealant, and optionally chinking or caulking.
